observation: Glass impact lacks energy: debris/shards appear as a small dark cluster near the window opening with minimal outward spread; brick trajectory/through-pass is not clearly readable.
expected_behavior: A high-speed brick striking the center of a large pane should produce a strong radial crack pattern and an outward burst of shards with clear separation and travel through space; the brick should visibly continue through trailing fragments.
actual_behavior: Shatter is subtle and localized; shards do not read as transparent/reflective glass and do not appear to travel far from the pane; the brick is hard to see and the action is not legible in-frame.
